About the station

The Readout Radio is an on-demand station, not a live stream: short briefings you can play anytime. Episodes are narrated by synthetic voice today; send a recording and it plays in your own voice instead. To add an episode, drop an MP3 in src/assets/audio/ and list it in src/_data/radio.json.
